status.detail: The public steps are sufficient and the issue is labelled reproducible. Elevation was already tested without resolving the mismatch.

next_action.reason: Compare screen, source and capture coordinates under Windows Magnifier rather than requesting another diagnostic ZIP.

judgment.rationale: The report gives a complete Windows Magnifier/Color Picker sequence, screenshot and diagnostic ZIP, and explicitly confirms the problem also occurs when elevated.
evidence: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/31800 reports 0.79.0 and a selected color differing from the pixel visually under the pointer when Windows Magnifier exceeds 100%.
https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/31800#issuecomment-1985434850 confirms elevation does not eliminate the issue.
Live labels include Status-Reproducible and Priority-3.
Current MouseInfoProvider.UpdateMouseInfo calls GetCursorPosition, which uses GetCursorPos, then CopyFromScreen at those coordinates.
judgment.recommended_action: Use known-color patches to compare visual pointer position, capture coordinates and sampled values with Magnifier off and on before selecting a capture/mapping correction.

fix_assessment.rationale: A cursor/capture coordinate-space mismatch is a concrete applicable hypothesis. No linked fix was identified, and Color Picker's WinUI migration alone is not evidence that Windows Magnifier sampling was fixed.

proposed_fixes.title: Sample the pixel visually under the pointer when Magnifier is active
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: GetCursorPos coordinates and CopyFromScreen's sampled desktop image do not describe the same visual point after Magnifier transforms the desktop, so the picker samples an unmagnified/source position rather than the displayed pixel under the pointer. Ordinary DPI conversion and capture-composition differences remain alternatives.
plan: Reproduce with large known-color patches, fixed display scaling and Windows Magnifier above 100%; record cursor, capture and visible patch positions with Magnifier off and in fullscreen/lens/docked modes.

Trace src/modules/colorPicker/ColorPickerUI/Mouse/MouseInfoProvider.cs GetCursorPosition and UpdateMouseInfo, identifying whether the discrepancy is pointer coordinates, magnification transform or the captured surface.

Choose a consistent supported coordinate/capture contract for the demonstrated mode; evaluate Windows Magnification APIs or an appropriate composited capture path rather than blindly dividing by zoom or substituting GetPhysicalCursorPos.

Keep click selection and live preview on the same sampled point, handle transform changes and unsupported capture failures safely, and add mapping tests for zoom, offsets and negative monitor coordinates.
verification: At 100% and 200% fullscreen Magnifier, point at the center of known solid-color patches and confirm preview and selected value match the visually indicated patch.
Repeat with pan offsets, lens/docked modes and mixed-DPI monitors to identify supported versus separately handled transforms.
Verify normal picking without Magnifier and both elevated/non-elevated execution; no regression in multi-monitor sampling.

confidence.rationale: The Magnifier-only trigger and current direct cursor-to-CopyFromScreen path strongly suggest a coordinate/capture boundary, but no runtime trace determines the exact transform correction.

issue_context.summary: Color Picker samples a different color than the one visibly beneath the pointer while Windows Magnifier is zoomed above 100%. The issue persists with administrator execution.
known_information: The supplied reproduction is: open Magnifier, zoom beyond 100%, invoke Color Picker and select a color.
The report already includes a screenshot and PowerToysReport_2024-03-08-18-22-22.zip.
The author explicitly repeated the test elevated with the same failure.
The live issue is open, unassigned and marked Status-Reproducible.
inferences: A transformed pointer/captured-surface mismatch is more consistent with the trigger than an elevation-only problem.
A single inverse-zoom formula may not cover fullscreen, lens and docked modes.
issue_context.analysis: The next discriminator requires maintainer-side known-color testing and coordinate tracing. Do not ask the reporter to repeat elevation or provide another generic archive.
initial_investigation: Read the complete report and its sole author comment; the public cross-reference timeline has no linked work.
Read current MouseInfoProvider.cs: GetCursorPosition calls GetCursorPos, while both initial/live sampling use CopyFromScreen and GetPixel.
Exact-number and Magnifier/Color PR searches identified no specific fix for this report. PR 49174 is a UI migration, not established Magnifier coverage.
No runtime reproduction or attachment content analysis was performed in this pass.

actions.label: Compare Magnifier visual and sampled pixels

reproduce.title: Color Picker under Windows Magnifier
prerequisites: Windows Magnifier and Color Picker enabled.
A simple test image/window with large red, green, blue and neutral solid-color patches; keep the pointer away from edges and anti-aliasing.
Record display scaling and Magnifier mode/zoom.
steps: With Magnifier off, pick the center of each patch and record the baseline color.
Enable fullscreen Magnifier above 100%, starting at 200%, and pick the visually indicated patch centers.
Pan the magnified desktop and repeat, recording pointer, capture and visual coordinates in a debug build.
Repeat in lens/docked modes and on a secondary monitor, then compare elevation without treating it as a required workaround.
Identify the first coordinate or captured-surface divergence before implementing a transform or capture change.
reproduce.expected_result: Live preview and committed color agree with the pixel visually under the pointer in supported Magnifier modes; ordinary and multi-monitor picking remain unchanged.
reproduce.setup_prompt: Create a harmless local image or test window with four large solid-color patches and labelled expected RGB values, using existing Windows tools. Provide steps to open it, run Windows Magnifier at 100% and 200%, and sample patch centers with Color Picker. Do not alter system color profiles, install software or modify PowerToys settings beyond the test.
